about: The hosted family's tool surface. Single source of truth: node Workers register from it, the hub filters tools/list by tier from it, and the A1 Bench fixture (a1-scout tests/bench/fixtures/gtm-mcp-tools.json) is a copy of it.

tier_rules.read: List and get, audits, observe-only QA. No writes.
tier_rules.stage: Adds writes inside the agent's own workspace, versions, autoresearch runs. Never Default Workspace, never live.
tier_rules.publish: Adds the publish request and the confirmed publish. Publish needs a passed QA session on the version and a person's confirmation id.
tier_rules.admin: Adds deletes and access changes. Always held for a person's confirmation.

tools.name: gtm_list_accounts
tools.description: List the GTM accounts this token can reach.

tools.name: gtm_list_containers
tools.description: List containers in an account.

tools.name: gtm_list_workspaces
tools.description: List workspaces in a container.

tools.name: gtm_list_tags
tools.description: List tags in a container (live version unless a workspace is given).

tools.name: gtm_get_tag
tools.description: Get one tag with its triggers, parameters and consent settings.

tools.name: gtm_list_triggers
tools.description: List triggers in a container.

tools.name: gtm_list_variables
tools.description: List variables in a container.

tools.name: gtm_get_live_version
tools.description: Get the published version's id, name and summary.

tools.name: gtm_diff_version
tools.description: Diff a version against the live version.

tools.name: gtm_create_agent_workspace
tools.description: Create this token's own workspace for staged changes. Returns its id.

tools.name: gtm_stage_tag
tools.description: Create or update a tag inside the agent's workspace. Include tag_id to update.

tools.name: gtm_stage_trigger
tools.description: Create or update a trigger inside the agent's workspace.

tools.name: gtm_stage_variable
tools.description: Create or update a variable inside the agent's workspace.

tools.name: gtm_create_version
tools.description: Create a version from the agent's workspace. Does not publish.

tools.name: gtm_request_publish
tools.description: Snapshot live to R2 and ask a person to confirm publishing a version. Needs a passed QA session on that version. Returns a confirmation request id.

tools.name: gtm_publish
tools.description: Publish a version a person has confirmed.

tools.name: gtm_delete_entity
tools.description: Delete a tag, trigger, variable or workspace. Held for a person's confirmation.

tools.name: gtm_set_user_permission
tools.description: Grant or change a user's access. Held for a person's confirmation.

tools.name: audit_run
tools.description: Run the container audit (broken references, duplicates, naming, unused, legacy tags, folders).

tools.name: audit_get_report
tools.description: Get a finished audit report.

tools.name: audit_consent_check
tools.description: Check Consent Mode v2 settings on every tag.

tools.name: audit_ads_alignment
tools.description: Match GTM conversion tags to active Google Ads conversion actions.

tools.name: qa_start_preview
tools.description: Open a preview session for the live version or a given version on a page.

tools.name: qa_check_event
tools.description: Assert that an event fired in a preview session with the expected parameters.

tools.name: qa_get_evidence
tools.description: Get redacted evidence (tags fired, dataLayer pushes, consent state) from a preview session.

tools.name: sgtm_container_health
tools.description: Status, domains and error rate of a server container.

tools.name: sgtm_get_logs
tools.description: Recent request logs from a server container.

tools.name: sgtm_capi_health
tools.description: Meta CAPI health: event match quality, dedup rate, browser vs server split.

tools.name: autoresearch_queue_run
tools.description: Queue an autoresearch run. It never publishes.

tools.name: autoresearch_get_status
tools.description: Status and scorecard of a run.

tools.name: autoresearch_stage_winner
tools.description: Put a finished run's winning config into a new agent workspace for review.
